dream_light_growth: The household's fixed tea-time Alice is sleeping through: the real late-afternoon light over the bank, warm and slanting, frozen in place while the party moves round the table ('always six o'clock', ch007-p57; environment fixed.dream_growth).

schemes.key_bearing: sun due west at about 25 deg through the horse-chestnut over the table; the house facing the table and the grass beyond sit in full sun
schemes.fill: soft warm shade under the tree, bounce off the white tablecloth and the sunlit grass
schemes.practicals_note: Teapot steam catches the light as haze; no lamps or candles (architecture negative: no electric light).
schemes.quality: warm slanting dappled light on the long table, bright sunlit house and grass behind, gentle shade faces lifted by tablecloth bounce; held identical across all four states
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: warm slanting late-afternoon sunlight from the west filtering through a large shade tree onto a long tea table, soft dappled light on the white tablecloth and faces, the thatched house and dry grass behind in full golden-white sun, gentle bounce light from the cloth, drowsy still air, unchanging steady light
schemes.reason: 'A table set out under a tree in front of the house' (ch007-p01) gives the shade; the light itself is designed. The environment holds the sun steady across the four states for the frozen tea-time, so one scheme covers all.

state_notes.SCN-mad-tea-party-S01: Alice arrives from the wood and sees the house in full sun first; same scheme, framed on the sunlit side.

special_note: 'Always six o'clock' (ch007-p57) is dialogue and a stopped watch (SUP-012), not a change of light; no special scheme.
